operators.name: embedding_lookup_forward
semantics: Performs embedding lookup: output[i,j,:] = weight[indices[i,j], :] except when indices[i,j] == padding_idx, then output[i,j,:] = 0.
The input indices and weight must be on the same CUDA device as the output.
All tensor arguments support arbitrary strides; implementation should handle non-contiguous inputs by using their strides.
No gradient computation is required in this forward-only contract.
input x shape [64,1024] int64, weight shape [1000,2048] float32, padding_idx=0
output shape [64,1024,2048] float32, values gathered from weight, with rows for padding_idx zeroed
